Finally, we note that the constants obtained in Theorems 4, 5, 7 and 8, unlike Theorems 2 and 3, have very bad dependence on δ and d. In particular, in the case of degree five polynomials, an interesting problem that remains unaddressed is to find out what the optimum constant achievable in Theorem 4 is. Acknowledgements.
